setting: Humans arrive millennia after the Resonance Wars shattered the Aeon Coalition; ancient empires built on stolen psychic substrate now crumble as their foundation proves corrosive to all matter.

civs.name: the-shroud
civs.trait: distributed minds linked by quantum-foam, terrified of individuation

civs.name: the-luminaries
civs.trait: ex-biological architects who uploaded to stellar cores, now dimming

civs.name: the-deep-architects
civs.trait: subterranean reality-engineers who burrowed to find substrate stability

civs.name: the-ephemera
civs.trait: ghosts of short-lived species caught in temporal loops, desperate for escape
